title: Average out-of-pocket spend per hospitalisation case, net of reimbursement

metadata.source: NSS 80th round, Household Social Consumption: Health (Jan-Dec 2025), unit-level data, MoSPI
metadata.method: Indica tabulation of public microdata; weights = mult/100. Total expenditure (b7i15) minus insurance/employer reimbursement (b7i16); excluding childbirth.
